items.question: What iconographic attributes define the goddess visualized in meditation?
premises: The goddess possesses full and uplifted breasts.
These attributes qualify the deity as the object of meditation.
items.inference: The goddess to be visualized is characterized by bearing a half-moon and having full, uplifted breasts.
items.plain_english: Visualize the goddess who bears a half-moon and has full, uplifted breasts.
